title: America America
desc: Childhood friends, Surya, Shashank and Bhoomi decide to focus on their career after graduating. Later, Shashank and Bhoomi get married but fate has different plans for them.

title: Shakthi
desc: Sakthi dreams of becoming a superhero. His wish unexpectedly comes true when the girl he is helping secure college admission dies due to unforeseen circumstances.

title: Seetharama Kalyana
desc: Arya, a righteous man, falls in love with a small-town woman named Geetha, unaware of the obstacles that lie ahead for both of them.

title: Andhra King Taluka
desc: Sagar, a fan of the actor Surya Kumar, makes a life-altering sacrifice to fund his idol's milestone film. However, he jeopardises his own happiness and assets to ensure the production succeeds.
